phase: GMI Browse exact public-field match explanations

behavior.visible_change: Use the existing parent-label slot for one exact Company/Ticker/Product/Platform field that contains the complete normalized query; keep the topic title and total connection count.
behavior.decision: Suppress the hint for an empty normalized query, no connection field match, or a query already explained by the canonical topic OR parent label in the visible language. Do not use previously rendered hints to make this decision.
behavior.deterministic_order: Current supplied connection order, then company, ticker, product, platform. This is not result ranking or a current participation claim.
behavior.rendering: After the existing filter-pass guard, equality-update only the two direct language label text nodes. Restore canonical parent labels on Clear; preserve anchor/title/count node identity and row order.
behavior.exact_match_boundary: Flattened cross-field or path-only search results remain eligible but do not get a fabricated field explanation. Existing norm(), search corpus, matching, URL, state and public-admission owners are unchanged.

count_diagnostic.reason: A new raw-text assertion duplicated the shared count numeral. Existing count node is one numeral plus two language spans; unchanged DOM identity and rendered-language assertions replace that mistaken expectation.

reset_diagnostic.reason: Unscoped first Reset resolved to inert answer-side recovery after Browse reparenting. Test now activates the existing Reset inside data-gmi-browse.

visual_review.findings: Existing result secondary slot makes exact platform/product/company values visible. EN390 preserves the two Micron substring results with a company hint only on the evidenced HBM row. ZH320 field value and total connection badge fit; no product prose/control/style added. Current selected conventional DRAM stays distinct from search results; its HBM description false positive is recorded as the next separate fix.

limits: Explanation covers an exact public-field subset of existing search matches, not every path/language/cross-boundary match
Connection count remains all published connections on the topic; it is not a count of query-matching companies
Only the current admitted observation and retained public fields; no new data, admission, current delivery or exposure claim
Generated-main/CSS/JS component proof excludes full shared-shell/fonts, native OS IME, spoken assistive technology, live account/admission, current hosted CI and deployment
Repeated legacy regression detailed snapshots are retained in the hashed complete native report; this declared export projection retains every case result and all new search observations/geometry
Original model01 EFFECT_UNKNOWN/ROOT_UNVERIFIED and all Draft/release holds unchanged
next_finding: Both client and server description renderers use HBM substring matching; Conventional DRAM (non-HBM) receives the specialized HBM sentence. Next separate phase will bind that sentence to its canonical HBM topic identity without adding new prose/model data.
